sentences.en: I have always identified hard work with success in life.
sentences.zh: 我一直把努力工作视为人生成功的关键。

sentences.en: You can't identify silence with agreement when you visit Japan.
sentences.zh: 你不能因为在日本访问时看到沉默就认为对方同意了。

sentences.en: They were able to identify him by his wrist watch.
sentences.zh: 他们通过他的手表认出了他。

senses.zh: 认出，识别 - 支持，同情 -

mnemonic: iden（相同）+tify→和（记忆中）相同→认出
